title: AE31009: Aerospace Structural Analysis
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Prerequisites: AE21004
3 - 1 - 0: 4 CreditsAnalysis of Aircraft
Structures; Thin-walled structures based on elasticity approach; Torsion,
bending and shear of open and closed thin-walled cells; Structural instability;
Buckling of columns, linear and nonlinear theories, Southwell method, inelastic
buckling, buckling under nonconservative forces.Books:T H G Megson, Aircraft
Structures for Engineering Students, Edward ArnoldH Ashley, Engineering
Analysis of Flight Vehicles, Addison WesleyC K Wang, Introductory Structural
Analysis with Matrix Method, Englewood Cliffs, Prentice HallE F Bruhn, Analysis
and Design of Aircraft Structures, Tri-State Offset CoE E Sechler and L G Dunn,
Airplane Structural Analysis and Design, Dover

Concepts taught in class

Vibration analysis of Single degree of freedom systems, multi-degree of freedom systems and continuous systems

Student Opinion

{|class="wikitable"

||Material provided by the professor is more than sufficient for the course. As a support, he even provides tutorials to practice.

How to Crack the Paper

{|class="wikitable"

Classroom resources

NPTEL course on structural dynamics by Prof. P. Banerji would be helpful apart from resourses provided by professor.

Additional Resources

Prof. Banerji gives a glimpse on earth quake analysis, Building vibration analysis etc. Interested people can proceed using the references given by him.
